properties.name: The Bookbinders’ Railway
properties.brief: A timber side-friction coaster folds its train like the signatures of a book. Put the loading shed and chain lift in the western cell. Cross east on a high open trestle, fold into three progressively lower camelbacks around the binding court, then cross west on the low return. Show one oxblood train, linen awnings and the people stitching at their benches. Use the paired north-up plate and aligned ground-contact mask. Elevate the entire ride, including the station. Place the full base of every pier, brace, stair landing and ground-level prop inside white areas. Span black areas freely with track and cantilevers above the roofs and streets; leave the mapped ground intact. Keep the entire projected silhouette, moving vehicles and shadows inside the combined tile outline, including at the highest point. Carry the ride through the internal seam.

properties.name: The Rain Dividend
properties.brief: Arrange a water park among the existing blocks. Board four-seat boats under a striped canopy in the south. A water jet lifts them north across the seam in a pale ceramic flume. Curl around a header tank, drop south over the seam into a splash pool sized to the available clear ground, and drift back to the station. Give bathers a separate shallow terrace with tipping buckets and a dry spectator bridge outside the splash run. Use the paired north-up plate and aligned ground-contact mask. Fit the complete beds and banks of ground-level pools and channels, wet decks, landings, and every footing inside white areas. Link separate pockets by raised watertight flumes on clear-ground piers.
